title: No TRO, no halt: Gatchalian says Duterte trial to go on amid SC petition
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will proceed despite a petition before the Supreme Court challenging the Senate impeachment court’s new ruling on the voting…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte will proceed despite a petition before the Supreme Court challenging the Senate impeachment court’s new ruling on the voting threshold, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said Friday. Gatchalian said the Senate impeachment court would continue with the proceedings as long as there is no temporary restraining order (TRO) from the Supreme Court and the tribunal has a quorum. “Tuloy. Wala namang TRO so tuloy,” Gatchalian told reporters at the Senate. (We’ll proceed. There’s no TRO so we’ll proceed.) READ: VP defense team may still go to SC over conviction vote The […]...
